title: Sage barks record
description: A barks record (BarkRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another barks record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

speaker.description: Who the subtitle says is speaking; empty = the entity's name. May be a raw @key. (string, default "")

cooldown.description: Seconds between two lines from the same barker. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 4)

range.description: How near the player must be to see the line as a subtitle; 0 = anywhere. Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 25)

idleSeconds.description: Seconds between idle lines while it has no target; 0 = no idle lines. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 0)

lines.description: The lines, by occasion: alert, lost, hurt, idle, or a game's own word. (List<BarkLine>)

on.description: When it is said: alert, lost, hurt, idle, or a game's own word (the bark action) (string)

requires.description: When this line may be said: one condition, asked about the one barked at with the barker as the other; none = always. (ICondition)

text.description: What is said. May be a raw @key, resolved where it is shown. (string)

sound.description: A voice to play at the barker; give it no caption, the line is the subtitle. Names a sound record. (RecordRef<SoundRecord>)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.
